column2: Ikhawuntara exakekileyo. Akukho intanethi. Isakhupha iibhili.
Ukuthengisa, incwadi yamatyala, isitokhwe nencwadi yosuku — kwizixhobo zakho. Incwadi yosuku · Thengisa · Thenga · Izinto. Akukho gumbi lokutyela, akukho khitshi, akukho zitafile.
Cofa ibhili ukuze ulandele intengiso kwikhawuntara
Imigca engumzekelo yevenkile yokutya, hayi ikhawuntara yemali yokwenyani. I-Kirano ilandela indlela efanayo: thengisa → hlawulisa → incwadi yosuku.
Chwetheza i-atta, i-AT5 okanye elinye igama — umgca uwela kwibhili.
Inani ngeyunithi esetyenziswa yipakethe; ixabiso liyalandela.
Hlawulisa kwikhawuntara; incwadi yosuku ibhala indlela yokuhlawula.
Ityala ngaphandle kwe-CRM — libhale kwincwadi yabo yamatyala.
Hlawula kamva kuluhlu lwabathengi nababoneleli — inxalenye ngemali ephathekayo, inxalenye nge-UPI, ucime umgca.
Intsalela ingena kwincwadi yamatyala yomthengi — akukho enye i-app yeencwadi.
Amatyala abathengi kuwe namatyala akho kubaboneleli asencwadini enye yabathengi nababoneleli.
Lonke ityala nayo yonke intlawulo kuhlala kwincwadi yosuku.
Thenga kumthengisi omkhulu — isitokhwe nabo ubatyalayo kuhlaziywa kunye.
Isitokhwe sokuthengisa kwakhona — hayi izithako zasekhitshini. Ibhetshi nomhla wokuphelelwa ngokuzikhethela xa uthenga.
Intsalela yomboneleli ikwi-akhawunti efanayo nencwadi yamatyala yomthengi.
Uluhlu lwesitokhwe lubonisa okuphelayo phambi kwesiphithiphithi esilandelayo.
Imali ephathekayo ne-UPI, zibalwe ngokwahlukeneyo — kwaye umahluko uyachazwa.
Imali ephathekayo ne-UPI azize zixutywe zibe sisixa esinye esingaqondakaliyo.
Vala ishifti, shicilela isiliphu, uqalise elandelayo icocekile.
I-invoyisi yerhafu okanye irisithi yemali ephathekayo — ingxelo yosuku iqulethe zombini.
Incwadi yosuku · Thengisa · Thenga · Izinto — izikrini ezine, kwaye akukho gumbi lokutyela.
Ikhawuntara yemali yesibini: iqhagamshelwe kwi-Wi-Fi yakho
Xa i-intanethi inqamuka phakathi kwesiphithiphithi, akukho nto kwikhawuntara eyilindileyo.
Iikhawuntara zemali ezongezelelweyo zabelana ngeencwadi ezifanayo kuthungelwano lwevenkile.
Akukho mali ngentengiso, into, ikhawuntara yemali okanye i-PIN yomsebenzi ekufakweni kwisixhobo sakho.
I-Kirano efanayo kwifowuni esemva kwekhawuntara nakwikhawuntara yemali yekhompyutha.
Ngonyaka: Steady ₹6k · Swift ₹14k · Priority ₹28k ngaphandle kwerhafu (okanye uqikelelo lwexabiso olwenziwe ngokwezifiso). Thenga kwi-/shop.
Khuphela simahla, okanye usithumelele kwi-WhatsApp ukuze uboniswe ngokohlobo lwevenkile yakho nedolophu yakho.
Cofa ukuze uhlawulise — imali ephathekayo okanye i-UPI
Izifaki ziya kubekwa apha xa nganye iphumelele ukufakwa kumatshini omtsha. Okwangoku, cela umboniso kwi-WhatsApp.
Umgca womboniso we-WhatsApp uza kuvuleka kungekudala. Umyalezo wakho uza kufundeka ngolu hlobo: “{message}”.
I-akhawunti enye yesayithi nee-app — ifomu efanayo nokuba umtsha okanye uyabuya.
Siza kukuthumelela ikhonkco lokuseta kwakhona nge-imeyile. Sebenzisa idilesi efanayo obhalise ngayo.
Qhagamshela iindlela kwi-akhawunti enye ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisela ukufikelela ukuba enye iyasilela.
Izicwangciso zelifu zonyaka — irhafu yongezwa xa uhlawula. I-app epheleleyo ye-Kirano kwizixhobo zakho ihlala isimahla ngonaphakade, ngaphandle kwezibhengezo.
Inqwelo yakho ayinanto. Yongeza i-Steady, i-Swift okanye i-Priority.
Ukuhlawula kukungenisa kwiphepha le-akhawunti, emva koko kuqalise intlawulo (ukulinganisa kovavanyo okanye i-Paddle xa izitshixo zisetiwe).

Izicwangciso zonyaka — isango lokuhlawula longeza irhafu xa uhlawula. Ukusebenzisa kwisixhobo sakho kuhlala kusimahla ngonaphakade. Okwenziwe ngokwezifiso luqikelelo lwexabiso (lunokuba ngaphantsi kwe-Steady okanye ngaphezu kwe-Priority).
Sebenzisa igama lokugqitha elinoonobumba aba-6 ubuncinane.
Iinzame ezininzi kakhulu. Zama kwakhona kamva.
Sebenzisa inombolo yefowuni epheleleyo enekhowudi yelizwe (umz. +91…).
Loo khowudi ye-SMS ayichanekanga okanye iphelelwe lixesha.
Akukho akhawunti ine-imeyile leyo. Qhubeka ukuze uyenze, okanye usebenzise enye indlela.
Ngenxa yokhuseleko, ngena kwakhona, emva koko uzame olu tshintsho kwakhona.
Loo ndlela yokungena sele isetyenziswa yenye i-akhawunti.
Loo imeyile sele isetyenziswa yenye i-akhawunti.
Loo ndlela sele iqhagamshelwe kule akhawunti.
Sele ikho i-akhawunti ene-imeyile le esebenzisa enye indlela yokungena. Ngena ngaloo ndlela kuqala, uze uqhagamshele le kwiphepha le-akhawunti yakho.
Tshintsha igama lakho lokugqitha. Uza kuqinisekisa ngelangoku.
Yongeza igama lokugqitha ukuze ukwazi ukungena nange-imeyile (kuluncedo ukuba umboneleli akafumaneki).
Akukho mboneleli wokwenyani wokuhlawula ovuliweyo kwi-API yelifu (ukulinganisa kuphela okukwisixhobo sakho).
Ukuhlawula kuvaliwe — akukho ntlawulo igqityiweyo. Isicwangciso sakho asitshintshanga.
I-imeyile ayikaqinisekiswa — jonga ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo
I-akhawunti yenziwe. Jonga i-imeyile yakho ukuze uqinisekise xa ufumana ithuba.
Ukuba ikho i-akhawunti yaloo imeyile, ikhonkco lokuseta kwakhona lisendleleni. Jonga ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
I-akhawunti ka-{email} sele ikho nge-{method}. Ngena ngaloo ndlela kuqala, uze uqhagamshele lo mboneleli kwiphepha le-akhawunti yakho.
Phuma uze ungene kwakhona, emva koko uzame kwakhona.
Faka i-imeyile oza kuyisebenzisa ukungena ngegama lokugqitha.
Igama lokugqitha longeziwe. Ngoku unokungena nange-imeyile.
I-imeyile yokuqinisekisa ithunyelwe — jonga ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
Amaxabiso okuzithengela akakapapashwa kule mveliso. Cela uqikelelo lwexabiso olwenziwe ngokwezifiso okanye ubuye kamva.
Imveliso epheleleyo kwizixhobo zakho. Akukho mali yelifu.
